coach_says: Garmin shows UNPRODUCTIVE status with TSB at -54.8 and low readiness (41), so this week is built almost entirely around recovery, with Tuesday's non-negotiable hard AM hills + PM MTB group ride serving as the week's single quality/hard block. Everything else is easy Zone 1-2 endurance, one light recovery-focused gym session, an easy technique swim, and yoga to help restore balance without adding further fatigue. Weather-friendly Thursday and Sunday carry the aerobic volume, while Monday, Wednesday and Saturday are protected as true recovery days.

days.details: Full rest day to prioritise recovery given UNPRODUCTIVE Garmin status, TSB -54.8, and low training readiness (41). Optional light stretching or a short walk only if desired - no structured training.

days.session: AM Hills Threshold Ride + PM Committed Hard MTB Group Ride
days.details:
AM (before work, ~60 min) | Objective: Threshold/hill strength
10 min Zone 2 warm-up
5-6 x 3 min Zone 4 hill repeats (3 min easy spin recovery)
10 min cool-down

PM (after work, ~75 min) | Objective: Committed hard MTB group ride (non-negotiable)
Group ride at race-pace intensity over technical terrain. Treat as the week's key hard/anaerobic session - this is Tuesday's designated double hard day per athlete commitment, regardless of recovery status.

Lunch swim (~40 min) | Objective: Active recovery, technique focus, no hard or moderate effort per Wednesday constraint
Warm-up: 200m easy freestyle
Main: 4 x 100m easy technique-focused swim, 30 sec rest
Cooldown: 200m easy
Total: ~1000m, keep effort low throughout.

days.session: Easy Endurance Ride + Light Recovery-Week Gym
days.details:
AM ride (before work, ~50 min) | Objective: Aerobic endurance, best weather day of the week
10 min Zone 1 warm-up
30 min Zone 2 steady
10 min Zone 1 cool-down

Lunch gym (~45 min) - Workout A (light-moderate load, 2+ RIR, recovery week - not heavy):
Warm-up: 5-10 min easy bike + dynamic mobility
Romanian Deadlift 3x6
Bulgarian Split Squat 3x8
Chest Supported Row 3x10
Dumbbell Bench Press 3x10
Copenhagen Plank 3x20 sec
Dead Bug 3x8 each side
Main lifts: 2 min rest; Accessories: 60-90 sec rest. Separate from AM ride by 3+ hours.

90 min | Objective: Aerobic endurance (indoor trainer due to forecast drizzle)
15 min Zone 2 warm-up
60 min Zone 2 steady endurance
15 min Zone 1 cool-down
45 min gentle yoga flow focused on hip and thoracic mobility plus recovery breathing. Active recovery day given weather and accumulated weekly fatigue; no cycling scheduled.

120 min | Objective: Long aerobic endurance ride, best weather day, moderate volume given overall fatigue
20 min Zone 2 warm-up
80 min Zone 2 steady
20 min Zone 1 cool-down
